inlines.v: DIPLOMACY, noun [This word, like supremacy, retains the accent of its original.] 1. The customs, rules and privileges of embassadors, envoys and other representatives of princes and states at foreign courts; forms of negotiation. 2. A diplomatic body the whole body of ministers at a foreign court. 3. The agency or management of ministers at a foreign court.
